15.description: Evaporative loss flow rate as a function of culture volume and temperature.
15.quote: We have also included the $ F_{loss} $ term to account for evaporative loss during fermentation.

assumptions.text: The culture medium's freezing and boiling temperatures are taken to be those of water.
assumptions.quote: where $ T_0 $ and $ T_v $ are the freezing and boiling temperatures of the culture medium that were assumed to have the same properties as water, respectively.

assumptions.text: The evaporation rate is assumed to tend to infinity at the boiling point, represented using an exponent of 5.
assumptions.quote: We have assumed that the evaporation rate will tend to infinity at the boiling point, and for engineering purposes the exponent 5 is large enough to represent this.

assumptions.text: The evaporative-loss expression is treated as a heuristic rather than as an experimentally based relationship.
